title: tetradium daniellii
intro: Tetradium daniellii, commonly known as Szechuan pepper, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tetradium daniellii include analgesic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-arrhythmic effects, which may help alleviate pain, lower blood pressure, and regulate heart rhythm. Bioactive constituents of Tetradium daniellii include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
